# Recall.ai

Recall AI provides a unified API to integrate meeting bots and access conversation data from major video conferencing platforms, enabling seamless automation, transcription, and analysis of virtual meetings.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/recallai/.

## Actions

- **Create bot**: Create a new bot.
- **Delete bot**: Delete a bot by id.
- **List bots** (read-only): List all bots
- **List chat messages** (read-only): Get list of chat messages read by the bot in the meeting(excluding messages sent by the bot itself).
- **Remove bot from call**: Removes the bot from the meeting.
- **Retrieve bot** (read-only): Get a bot instance.
- **Start recording**: Instructs the bot to start recording the meeting.
- **Stop recording**: Instructs the bot to end the current recording.
